digest.component_or_area: complexity baseline wrapper and ratchet gate
propositions: Implement a shrink-only C901 complexity baseline that records ceilings for production functions in src/rebar and fails on new or increased complexity debt while allowing improvements.

Create a wrapper script check_complexity_baseline.py that accepts Ruff C901 findings in JSON format, compares against the baseline, and computes active/new/increased/stale counters with guarded --update-stale maintenance mode.

Generate and commit .github/complexity-baseline.json with schema_version 1 and one ceiling entry per live C901 finding keyed as repository-relative-posix-path::qualified-symbol, rejecting duplicates and unsorted entries.
Wire the complexity wrapper into make lint to enforce the gate on production code only (src/rebar) while preserving existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests.
Implement symbol identity from Python AST to resolve nested functions with equal leaf names under different parents and reject same-qualified-key redefinitions as normalization failures.
